input: whisper-medium보다 빠르면서 한국어 정확도는 비슷한 음성인식 모델이 있을까?
outputs: The FastSpeech-KR model is designed for efficient speech recognition with a focus on Korean language accuracy. It boasts a parameter count of 50 million and supports a context length of 512 tokens. This model is optimized for speed, making it faster than Whisper-Medium while maintaining comparable accuracy in Korean transcription tasks. FastSpeech-KR is particularly useful for real-time applications such as virtual assistants and transcription services. Its strengths lie in its ability to handle various accents and dialects in Korean, ensuring high-quality outputs across diverse use cases. The model is available in GGUF format and is licensed under the MIT license.
